class.name: NetwReparentOpts
class.brief_description: Reason metadata for one [method NetwEntity.reparent_to] call.
class.description: The destination is passed to [method NetwEntity.reparent_to]. This object carries the reason reported with the move. [codeblock] var opts := NetwReparentOpts.new() opts.reason = &"boarded" NetwEntity.of(self).reparent_to(next_room, opts) [/codeblock]

members.member: Optional gameplay label for the reparent. It does not reach [signal NetwEntity.reparented], which reports a completed move and carries no arguments. It reaches an observer in the detail of [constant NetwMultiplayer.EVENT_REPARENTED] instead.
